checks.name: install into an existing journey adopts and resumes the same tab without focusing it
checkbox draft is durable and has no granted authority
extension, hosted, provisioning and Bridge navigation preserve the same browser tab
controlled fixture Brain restart reconnects its event stream without polling or a new tab
worker restart restores durable draft and reuses the current trusted page
repeated explicit toolbar opens reuse the workspace without resetting its current route
closing and reopening the workspace restores its draft without modifying a user tab
existing OnlyFans tab retains its document and unsaved draft with zero navigation or reload

scope: Real bundled MV3 coordinator and browser lifecycle; fixture hosted and Brain services; no production sign-in, app installer, pairing, or live OnlyFans account.
limitations: Existing pre-install documents cannot be assumed to gain chrome.runtime. This package automatically navigates only the exact registered setup tab to its extension route; it never reloads OnlyFans.

The first-party origin permission is necessary to find and validate pre-install workspace tabs without a broad tabs permission. Production manifest and customer permission-copy review belong to integration.

Controlled restart uses a real stopped/restarted HTTP event-stream fixture, not the Windows Brain executable. Authentication/session re-establishment, installed app protocol and production shutdown ordering remain integration gates.
